title: 1RB---_1LC0LD_0RF0LD_0LE0RA_0LC1RA_1RC1RD: the exits of the region closed for k < 20, so halting is exactly the extended orbit
text: Every one of the 2,502 starts Z<sub>k</sub>, n < 12k+12 with k < 20 (besides n = 2 and the halting line) is followed to its fate and checked in Lean with the list simulator: 7 halt, every other one is back at a tail of the proved map within 12 passes. With the map extended by this table, the machine halts exactly when the extended orbit from blank tape halts, as long as that orbit never meets a region start with k ≥ 20. The exit words themselves do not form a small family. 10<sup>6</sup> passes of the orbit keep the tightest margin at 55 (pass 28).
